description: Plugins that hold no data to move but need a named cutover task. An installed or fingerprinted plugin whose folder slug, or main-file name, matches an entry becomes one coverage row: status manual-mapping, basis list, via manual, the entry's manualSteps verbatim, and cutoverTask { workType, task, doneWhen }. The row reaches the Cutover Operator through the census (state manual) and the discovered-set status (manual-open). An entry never hides data: if the run attributes readable data to the plugin, that data keeps its own row and the task is added beside it. Signed (decidedBy, decidedOn); unsigned entries fail validation and are ignored at runtime. A slug here may not also have a profile, a no-migration-needed hint, or a toolkit entry.

workTypes.manual-setup: The owner must configure an applicable setting or account.
workTypes.missing-apps: A specific required destination app is verified absent.
workTypes.changed-behavior: Data exists but the intended functionality differs or needs a solution.
workTypes.checks: A specific configuration or customer flow needs a bounded verification.
workTypes.review: An unfamiliar capability needs investigation or a decision.

tasks.does: Sends store events to Google Analytics.

manualSteps.prerequisite: Access to the store's Google Analytics property.

steps.text: In Google Analytics, copy the GA4 measurement ID the store used.
In the Wix dashboard, open Marketing Integrations > Google Tag and connect that measurement ID. Wix sends store events (view item, add to cart, purchase) by itself.

tasks.doneWhen: Google Analytics Realtime shows a visit to the Wix site.

tasks.does: Connects Google Analytics, Search Console and other Google services.
tasks.task: Reconnect Google Analytics and Search Console

manualSteps.prerequisite: Access to the Google accounts the plugin used.

steps.text: In the Wix dashboard, open Marketing Integrations > Google Tag and connect the same GA4 measurement ID.
In Marketing & SEO, verify the site with Google Search Console (the Wix SEO setup connects it).

tasks.doneWhen: GA Realtime shows a Wix visit, and Search Console lists the Wix site as verified.

tasks.does: Sends products to Google Merchant Center and runs Google Shopping ads.

manualSteps.prerequisite: Access to the Google Merchant Center and Google Ads accounts.

steps.text: In the Wix dashboard, open Google & YouTube and connect the existing Merchant Center account (remove the old WooCommerce feed in Merchant Center first).
In Google Ads, check that Shopping campaigns now use the Wix product feed.

tasks.doneWhen: Merchant Center shows the Wix products as approved.

tasks.does: Adds ad pixels (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and more) to the site.

manualSteps.prerequisite: Access to the ad accounts and their pixel IDs.

steps.text: On the source site, note which ad pixels and IDs the plugin sends (Meta Pixel, Google Ads, TikTok).
In the Wix dashboard, open Marketing Integrations and connect each one: Meta Pixel & CAPI, Google Ads Conversions, TikTok Pixel.
Use the same pixel and account IDs so ad reporting continues.

tasks.doneWhen: Each pixel's own tool shows events from the Wix site (for example Meta Events Manager test events).

tasks.does: Builds product feeds for Google, Facebook and other shopping channels.

manualSteps.prerequisite: Access to each shopping channel's account.

steps.text: On the source site, list which channels the feeds were sent to.
For each channel, connect it in the Wix dashboard: Google & YouTube, Facebook Catalog (Marketing Integrations), or the channel's Wix sales channel. Wix builds and updates the feed itself.
In each channel's account, replace the old feed URL with the Wix one.

tasks.doneWhen: Each channel shows products from the Wix feed.

tasks.does: Adds code snippets (tracking, verification tags) to every page.

steps.text: On the source site, copy each active snippet and note where it loads (head or body).
Prefer a Marketing Integration if one covers the snippet (Google Tag, Meta Pixel). Otherwise add it in Settings > Custom Code with the same placement.

tasks.doneWhen: Each snippet's tool sees the Wix site (or its verification passes).

tasks.does: Runs custom PHP, JS and CSS snippets on the site.

steps.text: On the source site, list each active snippet and what it does.
Re-add tracking or display snippets in Settings > Custom Code.
For snippets that change store behavior (PHP), decide what replaces them on Wix, or record that they are not needed.

tasks.doneWhen: Every active snippet is re-added on Wix or recorded as not needed.
tasks.note: PHP snippets can hold business logic; this is a decision for the owner, not a copy step.

steps.text: In the Wix dashboard, open Privacy & Cookies and click Add to Site next to the cookie consent banner.
Set the banner text and languages to match the old one.

tasks.doneWhen: The live Wix site shows the cookie banner on first visit.

tasks.does: Adds an accessibility toolbar for visitors.

steps.text: In the Wix editor, run the Accessibility Wizard and fix what it finds.
If the owner wants a visitor toolbar like the old one, add an accessibility app from the Wix App Market.

tasks.doneWhen: The Accessibility Wizard shows no open issues, and the toolbar is live if the owner chose one.

steps.text: On the source site, list each popup, its text, and when it shows.
In the Wix editor, add a popup (lightbox) for each one still wanted, with the same trigger.

tasks.doneWhen: Each wanted popup shows on the Wix site.

steps.text: On the source site, note the button's phone or WhatsApp number.
In the Wix editor, add a fixed contact button (or a chat/WhatsApp app) with the same number.

tasks.doneWhen: The Wix site shows the contact button and it opens the right number.

steps.text: On the source site, list the pages that show a slider and save its images and text.
In the Wix editor, add a slideshow or gallery on the same pages with those images and text.

tasks.doneWhen: Each slider page on Wix shows its slideshow.

tasks.does: Sends visitors to a thank-you page after a form is sent.

steps.text: On the source site, note each form's redirect URL.
In the Wix editor, open each imported form > Edit Form > Settings, and under When a form is submitted choose Redirect to a URL with the matching page.

tasks.doneWhen: Sending each form on Wix lands on its thank-you page.

manualSteps.prerequisite: The owner's chosen payment provider account.

steps.text: In the Wix dashboard, open Settings > Accept Payments and connect the payment provider the owner chooses.
Make a test purchase and refund it.

tasks.doneWhen: A test order on Wix is paid and refunded.
tasks.note: Past payments come across with the orders. Gateway settings and keys are never read.
